summary: Integrated Media Technology Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of non-executive director Ms. Jannu Binti Babjan, effective May 26, 2026. The filing states the resignation was not due to any disagreement with the company regarding operations, policies, or practices. The board expressed appreciation for her contribution. No terms, prices, or premiums are involved. As a non-US issuer, this Form 6-K serves as the equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K for a director departure. Watch for any further board changes or follow-on disclosures.
